prompt:
Create a complete 1440 × 900 desktop developer portfolio homepage for John Paul Fernandez, edge to edge with no browser frame. The page helps potential clients and collaborators understand his real profile, technology range, and product-building approach. Use the supplied portrait reference and preserve his identity.

This is another composition in the chosen Cutaway Folio visual world, guided by the original architectural cutaway. Keep the cobalt, coral-red, acid-yellow, chalk, and graphite palette, strong editorial type, and precise section-drawing marks. Use flat graphic planes only: no literal building, rooms, offices, furniture, plants, device mockups, or invented logo. In this version, the name and role lead across the upper-left, while a contained portrait sits left of center. Three broad, parallel cutaway bands sweep diagonally across the right half and lower center, each carrying one clear heading—Interfaces, Applications, Backend systems—and its actual technology labels. Place the real profile paragraph and a single “See my work” action in a calm chalk panel at lower-left. Keep the visitor’s reading order obvious and the bands visually joined as one section, with plenty of quiet space around the portrait and copy. Start Selected projects on a clear chalk strip at the bottom.

Use exactly “John Paul Fernandez”, “Full Stack Developer”, “Fast, clear, dependable web products”, “I like building web products that feel fast, clear, and dependable. Most of my work lives at the intersection of React interfaces, Next.js apps, and backend systems that are simple to scale and maintain.”, “3+ years building web products”, “Interfaces”, “Applications”, “Backend systems”, “Selected projects”, “Project writeups are not published yet”. Include only React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Docker, Git, Firebase, Nginx and navigation About, Work, Experience, Contact. Add no projects, clients, employers, metrics, testimonials, labels, or claims beyond this content.
